courses.title: Model Context Protocol (MCP): Hands-On with Agentic AI
courses.why: Connecting LLMs to tools and data with MCP, including building MCP servers in Python and TypeScript: the agent tool-use half of this path, in under an hour.

courses.title: Advanced RAG Applications with Vector Databases
courses.why: Chunking, embeddings and metadata optimisation for retrieval, plus multimodal RAG: the depth behind the RAG chapter's interview questions.

courses.title: Building with the Claude API
courses.duration: 11 sections, about 85 lessons, exercises and quizzes
courses.why: Anthropic's free official developer course: prompting, tool use, RAG, MCP and agent workflows on the Claude API. Longer than the others, but you use Claude daily, and it gives a completion certificate.

portals.name: DeepLearning.AI short courses
portals.what: About 100 short, hands-on courses (most around an hour), including AI Agents in LangGraph with LangChain's founder, retrieval and MCP.

portals.name: Hugging Face LLM Course
portals.what: A free course on transformers and LLMs: tokenizers, fine-tuning, datasets and building reasoning models.

portals.name: Claude cookbooks (Anthropic, GitHub)
portals.what: Runnable notebooks for RAG, tool use, agents, evals, prompt caching and structured output: good patterns to copy into your project.

assessments.name: Hugging Face AI Agents Course certificate
assessments.format: Self-paced: Unit 1 for the fundamentals certificate; Unit 1, a use-case assignment and a final challenge for the certificate of completion. No deadline.
assessments.why: The quickest agent credential to earn, and the final challenge is real agent-building work.

assessments.name: Microsoft Applied Skills: Develop a Generative AI Chat App Using the Microsoft Foundry SDK
assessments.format: Hands-on, unproctored interactive lab in Python or C#: deploy a model in Microsoft Foundry, build a chat app with the Foundry SDK, implement chat history. 72-hour wait between lab launches.
assessments.credential: Microsoft Applied Skills credential on your Microsoft Learn profile, shareable to LinkedIn
assessments.why: A free, performance-based credential (you build it in a lab rather than answer multiple choice), from a major cloud vendor.

assessments.name: Google Cloud Generative AI Leader
assessments.format: 50–60 multiple-choice questions in 90 minutes; online or onsite proctored
assessments.credential: Google Cloud certification, valid for 3 years
assessments.why: Business-oriented rather than hands-on, so less weight for an engineering role; worth it mainly if you want a cheap Google Cloud GenAI badge quickly.

assessments.name: AWS Certified Generative AI Developer – Professional (AIP-C01)
assessments.format: 75 multiple-choice and multiple-response questions in 180 minutes; Pearson VUE test centre or online proctored
assessments.credential: AWS professional-level certification with a Credly badge
assessments.why: The most demanding developer-focused GenAI certification of the four; worth it once you have built the RAG and agent project.
